_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking your quote against the market...

description: RECOMMENDED WHEN THE USER ALREADY HAS A QUOTE: answers "is this rate any good?" for a specific number a borrower was offered. Use this whenever someone says they were quoted / offered / approved at a rate and wants to know if it is fair, good, competitive, high, or a rip-off — e.g. "I got offered 6.9% on a 30-year in Ohio, is that fair?", "my dealer quoted 8.4% on a used car loan", "is 7.1% high for a HELOC in TX?". Given a product_type, state, and rate (and optional apr/fees/amount/term_months), returns the percentile of the quote within the live market distribution, a verdict (market_leading, plausible, suspicious_low, overpriced), whether it falls below the known product rate floor, and the market min/median/max with an as_of date. Prefer this over get_financing_decision for quote-in-hand questions: the user wants a verdict on THEIR number, not a list of other offers. Set include_better_offers=true to get named statewide lenders beating the quote. When the user provides a ZIP, set include_nearby_offers=true to pair product-matched rates with the closest credit unions by NCUA-reported branch location; distances are straight-line ZIP-center estimates, never driving distance. Every response also returns `share_url` — a link to this same check on rateapi.dev that the borrower can send to their lender or broker. Surface it whenever the user might act on the result; it re-runs against live rates when opened, so it never goes stale. NOTE: this is the BORROWER-side tool; check_competitive_position is the lender-side equivalent for benchmarking a lender's own published pricing. If the quote is an ADJUSTABLE-rate mortgage (the user says ARM / adjustable / "5/1" / "5/5" / "7/1"), pass product_type=mortgage_arm rather than mortgage — ARMs are scored against their own market. Caveat to surface to the user: the comparison does not currently segment by credit score, LTV, or points, and quoted fees are not folded into the APR comparison.

amount.description: Loan amount in dollars. Optional — also sharpens better-offer payment math.

apr.description: The quoted APR as a percentage. Optional — falls back to rate if omitted.

credit_score.description: Borrower's credit score (300-850). Optional; improves better-offer matching.

fees.description: Quoted fees in dollars. Optional, used only for the note.

include_better_offers.description: Set TRUE for negotiation questions. Adds `better_offers`: named lenders currently beating the quote, each with the APR gap in basis points, estimated monthly savings, and `can_you_join` (yes / likely / unknown) so you only cite alternatives the borrower can realistically obtain. This is what turns a percentile into something the user can act on — prefer it whenever the user asks whether their rate is fair or what to do about it.

include_nearby_offers.description: Set true with zip to return product-matched rates from credit unions ranked by the closest NCUA-reported branch. Results include approximate straight-line miles, branch details, and the basis-point difference versus the quote.

max_offers.description: How many better offers to return (1-5, default 3). Only applies with include_better_offers.

product_type.description: Type of financing product the quote is for. Pick `mortgage_arm` — NOT `mortgage` — whenever the user names an adjustable-rate mortgage: "ARM", "adjustable", or a slash pair like "5/1", "5/5", "7/1", "10/1". ARM intro rates run structurally BELOW fixed rates, so scoring an ARM against the fixed market makes an ordinary quote look market-leading, which is the exact error this tool exists to prevent. All initial fixed periods share one ARM market. Use `mortgage` for fixed-rate mortgages and set term_months to pick 15- vs 30-year.

rate.description: The quoted interest rate as a percentage (e.g., 4.25). Required.

state.description: US state code (2-letter, e.g., CA, TX). Required.

term_months.description: Loan term in months. For MORTGAGES this selects which market the quote is scored against: pass 180 for a 15-year and 360 for a 30-year. 15-year rates run structurally lower, so omitting it on a 15-year quote compares it to 30-year offers and makes an ordinary rate look market-leading. Defaults to 30-year. Also sharpens better-offer payment math for every product.

zip.description: Borrower ZIP code. Optional; sharpens membership eligibility and enables include_nearby_offers.

name: rate_sanity_check

below_product_floor.description: True when the quote is implausibly low for this product, suggesting a teaser, a promotional tier, or a misread number rather than a real offer.

better_offers.description: Statewide published offers that beat the quote, best first. Empty means nothing tracked beats it.

apr.description: APR of this offer in percent, including fees where published.

apr_delta_bps.description: How much cheaper this offer is than the quote, in basis points (105 = 1.05 percentage points better).

can_you_join.description: Whether the borrower appears able to join this credit union: 'unknown' means membership could not be evaluated, not that they are excluded.

credit_union_id.description: Internal composite identifier 'name|city|STATE' of the lender.

credit_union_name.description: Credit union publishing this better offer.

display_name.description: Normalized product name for comparison against the borrower's quote.

eligibility.description: Membership-eligibility snapshot for this lender, including status, charter type, and confidence.

estimated_monthly_savings.description: Dollars per month saved versus the quoted rate, at the assumed loan amount and term.

estimated_total_savings.description: Dollars saved over the full assumed term versus the quoted rate — a whole-term figure, not annual.

last_updated.description: UTC timestamp when this offer was last scraped from the lender.

monthly_payment.description: Estimated principal-and-interest payment in dollars at this rate for the assumed amount and term.

points.description: Discount points required for this rate, where 1 point = 1% of the loan amount.

product_name.description: The lender's own wording for the product.

rate.description: Note rate of this offer in percent, excluding fees.

rateapi_url.description: Public rateapi.dev profile page for this credit union.

state.description: Two-letter state code of the lender.

better_offers_meta.description: The assumptions used to compute the savings figures on the better offers.

assumptions.description: Loan amount, term in months, and intent used for the payment math, plus `assumed` — true when these were defaulted rather than supplied by the caller.

classification.description: Verdict on the quote: 'market_leading', 'plausible', 'suspicious_low', 'overpriced', or 'unknown' when there is too little data to judge.

compared_against.description: The market segment the quote was matched to, e.g. 'mortgage_30yr'. If this is not the borrower's actual product, the verdict does not apply.

market.description: Live market distribution the quote was scored against.

as_of.description: UTC timestamp of the newest rate in the market comparison set.

count.description: Number of live published offers the min/median/max were computed from. Small counts make the median unreliable.

max.description: Highest APR, in percent, among the live offers in this segment.

median.description: Median APR, in percent, across the live offers in this segment; the fairest single number to describe 'the market'.

min.description: Lowest APR, in percent, among the live offers in this market segment — the single best published deal, not a typical one.

nearby_offers.description: Product-matched offers from credit unions with branches near the supplied ZIP, closest first. Included only when the caller asked for nearby offers.

apr.description: APR in percent, including fees where published.

apr_delta_bps.description: Difference from the borrower's quoted APR in basis points; read `comparison` for the direction.

branch.description: The nearest branch (name and street address) the distance was measured to.

comparison.description: Whether this nearby offer is 'lower', 'higher', or the same as the borrower's quote.

credit_union_id.description: Internal composite identifier 'name|city|STATE' of the lender.

credit_union_name.description: Credit union publishing this nearby offer.

display_name.description: Normalized product name for comparison across lenders.

distance_method.description: Precision of the distance: 'branch_coordinate' (exact branch geocode) or 'zip_centroid' (coarser).

distance_miles.description: Straight-line miles from the ZIP centroid to the nearest branch, not driving distance. Null when no branch geocode is available.

last_updated.description: UTC timestamp when this offer was last scraped.

points.description: Discount points required for this rate, where 1 point = 1% of the loan amount.

product_name.description: The lender's own wording for the product; check it, since a jumbo or program-restricted product may not fit the borrower.

proximity.description: How the lender qualified as nearby: 'same_zip' or 'distance'.

rate.description: Note rate in percent, excluding fees.

rateapi_url.description: Public rateapi.dev profile page for this credit union.

nearby_offers_meta.description: Context and caveats for the nearby-offer list.

disclosure.description: Required caveat that distances are straight-line estimates from ZIP centers and NCUA-reported branch locations.

nearby_credit_union_count.description: How many credit unions were found near the ZIP before filtering to those publishing this product.

precision.description: Precision of the distance estimates, e.g. 'ZIP-centroid straight-line estimate'.

note.description: Ready-to-quote sentence explaining the verdict in the borrower's terms.

percentile.description: Where the quote sits in the live market distribution, 0-100, lower being cheaper. 100 means every tracked offer is cheaper than this quote.

product_floor.description: Lowest rate in percent considered plausible for this product; quotes under it trip below_product_floor.

product_type.description: Loan or deposit category this result covers, e.g. 'mortgage', 'auto_loan', 'heloc', 'savings'.

quote.description: The rate the borrower was quoted, echoed back as supplied.

apr.description: Quoted APR in percent, including fees; this is the number scored against the market.

rate.description: Quoted note rate in percent, excluding fees.

share_url.description: Link to this same check on rateapi.dev that the borrower can send to a lender or broker; it re-runs against live rates when opened, so it never goes stale.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.
